title: EcoCard: Redeeming Sustainability Points for Rewards
summary: This document explains how to redeem EcoCard Sustainability Points in the Rewards section. You must have at least 3,000 available points, which are valued at $0.01 per point, and redemptions are processed after you select an amount, confirm the calculated value, and complete the request.
